main_body: A ladder-back chair seen from the front: two posts with three horizontal slats above a narrow seat, then two legs
top_band: No distinct top band. Column x=10 runs from outline (row 1) through light tan (rows 2-3, the top of the backrest) and mid-brown slats and gaps (rows 4-11) to a light front-edge line (row 12). The seat rows 10-11 (L about 117-124) stay in the same tone family as the front, so they do not read as a top.
evidence: The seat is only a 2-row band (rows 10-11) in a mid tone close to the rest of the chair, with a 1-row light edge at row 12. This matches the guide's 'thin seat' and 'band 2' red examples, and the seat surface is not seen from above. The backrest slats and posts are drawn flat and face-on. The back is a vertical face, and the 2-row cap at rows 2-3 is the top of the backrest, not a horizontal surface. The drawing is a front elevation with a thin seat, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The wood has about 4 tones (light tan, mid brown, dark brown, pinkish brown). There is no grain or texture, only flat slats. The outline is partly pure black (rows 14-15) and partly brown, and 58% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so it reads as mixed with a sticker look. It is clearly thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
